description: Places an order for one product from a BuyNearby store. Creates a real order; the customer receives a payment link by text or email, the card is held and is only charged after the store confirms the order. Guests provide name, phone and email; signed-in customers' saved details are used.

requested_by_time.description: Any parseable date/time, e.g. 'today 22:00' - recorded on the order, not an enforced SLA at this tier

name: place_order
